header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation is received. Perusal
body: of prayer clause “A” of this petition reflects that petitioner has prayed to constitute a Joint Investigation Team (JIT) and for re-investigation of the matter. On further perusal of the record, it reflects that the case has been challaned and the Court has taken cognizance. Therefore, this petition being not maintainable stands dismissed alongwith listed application (s). JUDGE JUDGE *Chander Kumar*
